Plan Your Conference with Clear Application Responsibilities

SYNC supports your conference application to the Saudi Conventions and Exhibitions General Authority (SCEGA), from classification review and document preparation to submission coordination and follow-up. For conferences in Riyadh, Jeddah and across Saudi Arabia, we help connect the application information to your programme, venue and organizing team. SCEGA reviews the application and makes the licensing decision.
